text: Run the whole platform inside your own boundary — on-premises or air-gapped, on open-source software your team can read — and put agents to work on casework, records and requests.
An agent gathers the file, summarizes the history and drafts the response for a caseworker to review and send.
Push the archive once and search it by phrase or by meaning, with every result pointing to its document.
Workflows read incoming requests, sort them and route each to the right office, with every step on the record.
An agent drives legacy systems that have only a screen, by screenshot, mouse and keyboard, so modernization does not wait on a rewrite.
The products underneath, on one account, one key and one bill.
Our cloud or yours: air-gapped deployment, SSO, audit logs and a person to call.
Keyword and meaning in one query over the documents you push.
Workflows fired by a webhook or a schedule, with runs that survive a restart.
An agent that drives any app by screenshot, mouse and keyboard.
Sign-in through your identity provider, SCIM provisioning and org-scoped roles.
Open-weight models you can download and run on your own hardware.
The platform is open source and deploys on your own hardware or cloud, air-gapped if required, so it runs under your controls rather than as a service reached over the internet.
Staff sign in through your identity provider over OIDC, and SCIM creates and removes their accounts from your directory.
An audit trail you can query
Every request is a row: the organization and user who acted, the address they came from, what they called and what the server answered. An agent’s run is recorded the same way.
Secrets are held per organization in KMS. Tokens verify against a closed list of algorithms that includes the post-quantum ML-DSA-65.
